findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_data_sources · Private data: get_nursing_home, get_home_health_agency, get_hospice, get_facility_owner, find_facilities_by_owner, find_care_after_hospital, get_rehab_hospital, get_dialysis_facility, find_doctors_for_procedure, search_providers, get_doctor, get_hospital, get_hospital_prices, get_doctor_payments, find_health_plans, get_health_plan, get_data_sources · Public sink: find_nursing_homes, get_nursing_home_staffing, get_facility_owner.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_data_sources · Private data: get_nursing_home, get_home_health_agency, get_hospice, get_facility_owner, find_facilities_by_owner, find_care_after_hospital, get_rehab_hospital, get_dialysis_facility, find_doctors_for_procedure, search_providers, get_doctor, get_hospital, get_hospital_prices, get_doctor_payments, find_health_plans, get_health_plan, get_data_sources · Public sink: find_nursing_homes, get_nursing_home_staffing, get_facility_owner

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
